stationScope.evidence: BS|ENERGY's current official Ladeinfrastruktur page explicitly states Direct Payment prices of 0.53 EUR/kWh AC and 0.59 EUR/kWh DC, plus blocking fees of 0.05 EUR/min after 240 minutes for AC (08:00-23:00), after 90 minutes for DC up to 50 kW, and after 60 minutes for DC from 51 kW. The same official page states that ad-hoc charging is started by scanning the QR code on BS|ENERGY charging stations. Current BNetzA-derived station data independently identifies BS|ENERGY-owned EVSEs such as DE*LDK*E00210*1/*2 at Gerstäckerstraße 17 (200 kW) and DE*LDK*E00193*1/*2 at Rosenhagen 7 (75 kW). The prefix is recorded as observed evidence only; matching must remain operator-owned-network scoped and must not be applied to unrelated operators if a shared prefix is encountered.

roamingDeferred.reason: BS|ENERGY explicitly states that external EMP roaming prices vary by provider; no roaming price is propagated into the physical CPO tariff.

note: Direct-payment tariff from the current official BS|ENERGY infrastructure page. The discounted 0.46 EUR/kWh AC and 0.56 EUR/kWh DC Stromkunde tariff is intentionally not modeled here because it requires an eligible BS|ENERGY electricity contract linked to the Löwenladen account. No parking fee is added; BS|ENERGY states it does not itself levy parking fees, while site-specific parking rules may still apply.
